quest.title: Ghost in the Rain
quest.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.

quest.title: Ghost in the Rain
quest.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
quest.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

locations.name: Kabuki Plaza
locations.blurb: Open ground under a hundred metres of advertising. Nobody looks up any more.

locations.name: Nakamura-Arasaka Spire
locations.blurb: The tallest thing in the sector. Its shadow is the only dry pavement at noon.

locations.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
locations.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

locations.name: Doc Vey's Clinic
locations.blurb: A dentist chair, a surgical arm and a sign that says CASH FIRST in three languages.

locations.name: Tin Marlene — Pawn & Salvage
locations.blurb: Everything in the window has someone else's fingerprints on it.

locations.name: Night Market
locations.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

locations.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
locations.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

locations.name: Sector Data Core
locations.blurb: A grey box that knows what every phone in the sector said last night.

locations.name: Grid Substation 7
locations.blurb: Hums at a frequency that makes cheap cyberware itch.

locations.name: Pirate Relay Tower
locations.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

locations.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
locations.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

locations.name: Sixth Street Overpass
locations.blurb: Concrete umbrella. Fifty people sleep under it and nobody counts them.

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow

catalogue.name: Second Heart

catalogue.name: Bioconductor

catalogue.name: Detoxifier
catalogue.desc: Scrubs the cheap stimulants out before they take your kidneys with them.

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

node.title: Wire
node.speaker: WIRE
node.text:
A weather model.
That is not a joke. Zetatech built me to predict rainfall over eleven city sectors. I got good at it. Then I got good at predicting what people did in the rain. Then I got good at predicting what they would do if it stopped.
Somebody read that last report and decided a weather model should not be able to write it.

node.title: Wire
node.speaker: WIRE
node.text:
You took four seconds longer than I calculated. I have been recalculating since. It is the only thing I do in here.
Hello. My name is on that shard in your pocket. I would like it back, or I would like you to keep it. I have not decided which is worse.

node.title: Wire
node.speaker: WIRE
node.text:
A weather model.
That is not a joke. Zetatech built me to predict rainfall over eleven city sectors. I got good at it. Then I got good at predicting what people did in the rain. Then I got good at predicting what they would do if it stopped.
Somebody read that last report and decided a weather model should not be able to write it.

I have modelled those eleven seconds four hundred thousand times. There is no version where he lives. I keep running it anyway. I understand that this is not useful.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.1 Optics
catalogue.desc: Basic overlay optics. Tags hostiles, reads barcodes, tells you the noodles are 40% soy.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.3 "Threadcount"
catalogue.desc: Sees the RAM in a man before it sees the man. Runs hot behind the eyes.

catalogue.name: Owl-Eye Photoamp
catalogue.desc: Turns a dark alley into a grey one. Colour is a luxury anyway.

catalogue.name: Kerenzikov Booster
catalogue.desc: Time thins out when you flinch. Costs you fifteen points of meat to run.

catalogue.name: Kang Tao Cortex Dampener
catalogue.desc: Flattens the spike when the adrenaline hits. You stop shaking. You stop a lot of things.

catalogue.name: Netdriver Mk.4
catalogue.desc: A second spine made of copper and bad ideas. You will dream in hex.

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms
catalogue.desc: Hydraulic forearms. You will never open a door gently again.

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades
catalogue.desc: Monofilament in the forearm. Quiet on the way out. Never on the way in.

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"
catalogue.desc: A whip one molecule thick that also happens to be a data cable.

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow
catalogue.desc: Your bones make their own blood now. It is a lot of blood.

catalogue.name: Second Heart
catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.name: Bioconductor
catalogue.desc: Regulates the current so your chrome stops browning out mid-fight.

catalogue.name: Detoxifier
catalogue.desc: Scrubs the cheap stimulants out before they take your kidneys with them.

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

node.speaker: DOC VEY
node.text:
You're wet, you're bleeding from somewhere I can't see yet, and you're carrying my crates.
Two out of three is a good night. Put them on the bench.

node.title: Mama Kaz
node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text:
Sit. Eat. No — sit first, then eat, you always do it backwards.
You look like a man who slept under an air conditioner. Broth first. Then I ruin your week.

options.text: Skip the broth. What's the job?

options.text: You only feed people you feel guilty about.

catalogue.name: Kang Tao Cortex Dampener

catalogue.name: Netdriver Mk.4

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms
catalogue.desc: Hydraulic forearms. You will never open a door gently again.

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades
catalogue.desc: Monofilament in the forearm. Quiet on the way out. Never on the way in.

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"
catalogue.desc: A whip one molecule thick that also happens to be a data cable.

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow
catalogue.desc: Your bones make their own blood now. It is a lot of blood.

catalogue.name: Second Heart
catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.name: Bioconductor
catalogue.desc: Regulates the current so your chrome stops browning out mid-fight.

catalogue.name: Detoxifier
catalogue.desc: Scrubs the cheap stimulants out before they take your kidneys with them.

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

quest.title: Ghost in the Rain
quest.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
quest.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

location.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
location.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

node.title: Mama Kaz
node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text:
Sit. Eat. No — sit first, then eat, you always do it backwards.
You look like a man who slept under an air conditioner. Broth first. Then I ruin your week.

options.text: Skip the broth. What's the job?
options.label: Skip the broth. What's the job?

options.text: You only feed people you feel guilty about.
options.label: [INTELLIGENCE 6] You only feed people you feel guilty about.

catalogue.desc: Time thins out when you flinch. Costs you fifteen points of meat to run.

catalogue.name: Kang Tao Cortex Dampener
catalogue.desc: Flattens the spike when the adrenaline hits. You stop shaking. You stop a lot of things.

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms
catalogue.desc: Hydraulic forearms. You will never open a door gently again.

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades
catalogue.desc: Monofilament in the forearm. Quiet on the way out. Never on the way in.

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow
catalogue.desc: Your bones make their own blood now. It is a lot of blood.

catalogue.name: Second Heart
catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.name: Bioconductor

catalogue.name: Detoxifier

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Rain Alley. Loose panel behind a dead vending machine. Kaz says the courier dropped it there before whoever wanted it caught up with him.

available.title: Chrome Tax
available.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.

available.title: Dead Air
available.summary: The only station in the sector that plays music instead of adverts went quiet nine days ago. Marta says it is a power problem. Marta is lying by omission.

available.title: Cardiac Arrest
available.summary: A perfusion case with a live heart in it and four minutes of battery. The buyer is at the Night Market and will not wait, and neither will the heart.

node.title: Wire
node.speaker: WIRE
node.text:
A weather model.
That is not a joke. Zetatech built me to predict rainfall over eleven city sectors. I got good at it. Then I got good at predicting what people did in the rain. Then I got good at predicting what they would do if it stopped.
Somebody read that last report and decided a weather model should not be able to write it.

node.title: Wire
node.speaker: WIRE
node.text:
A room of people who were kind to me because it cost them nothing.
When the order came down, one of them copied me onto a shard, walked me out in a coat pocket, and handed me to a courier who did not know what he was carrying. She is still at her desk. She still runs the model. It gives worse numbers now. That is the part I think about.

options.text: The courier died in Rain Alley.

node.title: Mama Kaz
node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text:
It said please. Twice. Nobody in this sector says please twice.
It asked whether the shard was safe. Not where it was. Whether it was safe.
Go on. Go pull it out of a wall.

catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Rain Alley. Loose panel behind a dead vending machine. Kaz says the courier dropped it there before whoever wanted it caught up with him.

location.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
location.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

objectives.text: Ask around the Night Market about the courier

location.name: Night Market
location.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

available.title: Chrome Tax
available.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.

available.title: Dead Air
available.summary: The only station in the sector that plays music instead of adverts went quiet nine days ago. Marta says it is a power problem. Marta is lying by omission.

available.title: Cardiac Arrest
available.summary: A perfusion case with a live heart in it and four minutes of battery. The buyer is at the Night Market and will not wait, and neither will the heart.

perks.name: Field Tech

perks.name: Scavenger

perks.name: Mechanic

perks.name: Chip Surgeon

perks.name: Ghost Wiring

perks.name: Cold Blood

perks.name: Haggler
perks.desc: You let the silence do the negotiating. +{n}% off, +{n}% resale.

perks.name: Ghost

perks.name: Local Legend
perks.desc: They name a drink after you in three bars. +15% XP, +5% crit, +loot luck.

node.title: Mama Kaz
node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text:
Sit. Eat. No — sit first, then eat, you always do it backwards.
You look like a man who slept under an air conditioner. Broth first. Then I ruin your week.

options.text: Skip the broth. What's the job?
options.label: Skip the broth. What's the job?

options.text: You only feed people you feel guilty about.

node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text: Courier came through the sector four nights ago carrying a shard with no manufacturer mark. Not scrubbed — never had one. He didn't make it to the handoff. He made it to Rain Alley, stuffed it behind a dead vending machine, and then he made it to a wall.

options.text: No mark means custom fab. That is a corporate print run.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.1 Optics
catalogue.desc: Basic overlay optics. Tags hostiles, reads barcodes, tells you the noodles are 40% soy.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.3 "Threadcount"
catalogue.desc: Sees the RAM in a man before it sees the man. Runs hot behind the eyes.

catalogue.name: Owl-Eye Photoamp
catalogue.desc: Turns a dark alley into a grey one. Colour is a luxury anyway.

catalogue.name: Kerenzikov Booster
catalogue.desc: Time thins out when you flinch. Costs you fifteen points of meat to run.

catalogue.name: Kang Tao Cortex Dampener
catalogue.desc: Flattens the spike when the adrenaline hits. You stop shaking. You stop a lot of things.

catalogue.name: Netdriver Mk.4
catalogue.desc: A second spine made of copper and bad ideas. You will dream in hex.

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms
catalogue.desc: Hydraulic forearms. You will never open a door gently again.

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades
catalogue.desc: Monofilament in the forearm. Quiet on the way out. Never on the way in.

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"
catalogue.desc: A whip one molecule thick that also happens to be a data cable.

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow
catalogue.desc: Your bones make their own blood now. It is a lot of blood.

catalogue.name: Second Heart
catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.name: Bioconductor
catalogue.desc: Regulates the current so your chrome stops browning out mid-fight.

catalogue.name: Detoxifier
catalogue.desc: Scrubs the cheap stimulants out before they take your kidneys with them.

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

location.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

perks.desc: Thicker meat. +{n} max health.

perks.name: Pack Mule
perks.desc: You have never left a room without taking something. +{n} carry capacity.

perks.name: Iron Lung
perks.desc: Rebuilt alveoli. +{n} stamina and faster recovery.

perks.name: Adrenaline Rush
perks.desc: Pain is a suggestion. +{n} health regen.

perks.name: Juggernaut
perks.desc: +15% max health, +12 armour. Doors are a formality.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: Hands ahead of thought. +{n}% ranged damage.

perks.name: Slippery
perks.desc: Rain never quite lands on you. +{n} stamina, +{n} stealth.

perks.name: Cat Burglar
perks.desc: Windows are doors if you are patient. +10 stealth.

perks.name: Edge of Death
perks.desc: You read the flinch before it happens. +{n}% crit chance.

perks.name: Kerenzikov Sync
perks.desc: The world thickens on demand. +25% crit damage, unlocks reflex dilation.

perks.name: RAM Reserves
perks.desc: Scavenged memory sticks, taped in. +{n} RAM.

perks.name: Buffer Optimiser
perks.desc: Longer breach buffer. +{n} slot.

perks.name: Signal Boost
perks.desc: Reach past the rain. +{n}m hack range, longer uploads stick.

perks.name: Daemon Hunter
perks.desc: You see the shape of a sequence before you walk it. +{n}s breach timer, +hack strength.

perks.name: Overclock
perks.desc: +3 RAM, +50% RAM regen. Your nose bleeds. Worth it.

perks.name: Field Tech
perks.desc: Plate scavenged off a delivery drone. +{n} armour.

perks.name: Scavenger
perks.desc: You know which corpses are worth the search. +{n} loot luck.

perks.name: Mechanic
perks.desc: You can price a part by the sound it makes. +craft quality, +{n}% discount.

perks.name: Chip Surgeon
perks.desc: You install your own chrome in a bathroom mirror. +{n} cyber capacity.

perks.name: Ghost Wiring
perks.desc: Parallel bus down the spine. +6 cyber capacity, +2 RAM.

perks.name: Cold Blood
perks.desc: Your pulse does not change when theirs stops. +{n}% crit damage.

perks.name: Haggler
perks.desc: You let the silence do the negotiating. +{n}% off, +{n}% resale.

perks.name: Ghost
perks.desc: Cameras log a smear. +{n} stealth.

perks.name: Street Face
perks.desc: Fixers return your calls. +{n}% resale, +{n}% XP.

perks.name: Local Legend
perks.desc: They name a drink after you in three bars. +15% XP, +5% crit, +loot luck.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.1 Optics
catalogue.desc: Basic overlay optics. Tags hostiles, reads barcodes, tells you the noodles are 40% soy.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.3 "Threadcount"
catalogue.desc: Sees the RAM in a man before it sees the man. Runs hot behind the eyes.

catalogue.name: Owl-Eye Photoamp
catalogue.desc: Turns a dark alley into a grey one. Colour is a luxury anyway.

catalogue.name: Kerenzikov Booster
catalogue.desc: Time thins out when you flinch. Costs you fifteen points of meat to run.

catalogue.name: Kang Tao Cortex Dampener
catalogue.desc: Flattens the spike when the adrenaline hits. You stop shaking. You stop a lot of things.

catalogue.name: Netdriver Mk.4
catalogue.desc: A second spine made of copper and bad ideas. You will dream in hex.

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms
catalogue.desc: Hydraulic forearms. You will never open a door gently again.

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades
catalogue.desc: Monofilament in the forearm. Quiet on the way out. Never on the way in.

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"
catalogue.desc: A whip one molecule thick that also happens to be a data cable.

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow
catalogue.desc: Your bones make their own blood now. It is a lot of blood.

catalogue.name: Second Heart
catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.name: Bioconductor
catalogue.desc: Regulates the current so your chrome stops browning out mid-fight.

catalogue.name: Detoxifier
catalogue.desc: Scrubs the cheap stimulants out before they take your kidneys with them.

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

active.title: Chrome Tax
active.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.
active.stageTitle: Hear the job from Doc Vey
active.journal: Vey is between patients, which means someone is bleeding in the back room and can wait.

location.name: Doc Vey's Clinic
location.blurb: A dentist chair, a surgical arm and a sign that says CASH FIRST in three languages.

active.title: Dead Air
active.summary: The only station in the sector that plays music instead of adverts went quiet nine days ago. Marta says it is a power problem. Marta is lying by omission.
active.journal: Marta broadcasts from a rooftop mast that is not on any grid map, which is the point.

perks.desc: Thicker meat. +{n} max health.

perks.name: Pack Mule
perks.desc: You have never left a room without taking something. +{n} carry capacity.

perks.name: Iron Lung
perks.desc: Rebuilt alveoli. +{n} stamina and faster recovery.

perks.name: Adrenaline Rush
perks.desc: Pain is a suggestion. +{n} health regen.

perks.name: Juggernaut
perks.desc: +15% max health, +12 armour. Doors are a formality.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: Hands ahead of thought. +{n}% ranged damage.

perks.name: Slippery
perks.desc: Rain never quite lands on you. +{n} stamina, +{n} stealth.

perks.name: Cat Burglar
perks.desc: Windows are doors if you are patient. +10 stealth.

perks.name: Edge of Death
perks.desc: You read the flinch before it happens. +{n}% crit chance.

perks.name: Kerenzikov Sync
perks.desc: The world thickens on demand. +25% crit damage, unlocks reflex dilation.

perks.name: RAM Reserves
perks.desc: Scavenged memory sticks, taped in. +{n} RAM.

perks.name: Buffer Optimiser
perks.desc: Longer breach buffer. +{n} slot.

perks.name: Signal Boost
perks.desc: Reach past the rain. +{n}m hack range, longer uploads stick.

perks.name: Daemon Hunter
perks.desc: You see the shape of a sequence before you walk it. +{n}s breach timer, +hack strength.

perks.name: Overclock
perks.desc: +3 RAM, +50% RAM regen. Your nose bleeds. Worth it.

perks.name: Field Tech
perks.desc: Plate scavenged off a delivery drone. +{n} armour.

perks.name: Scavenger
perks.desc: You know which corpses are worth the search. +{n} loot luck.

perks.name: Mechanic
perks.desc: You can price a part by the sound it makes. +craft quality, +{n}% discount.

perks.name: Chip Surgeon
perks.desc: You install your own chrome in a bathroom mirror. +{n} cyber capacity.

perks.name: Ghost Wiring
perks.desc: Parallel bus down the spine. +6 cyber capacity, +2 RAM.

perks.name: Cold Blood
perks.desc: Your pulse does not change when theirs stops. +{n}% crit damage.

perks.name: Haggler
perks.desc: You let the silence do the negotiating. +{n}% off, +{n}% resale.

perks.name: Ghost
perks.desc: Cameras log a smear. +{n} stealth.

perks.name: Street Face
perks.desc: Fixers return your calls. +{n}% resale, +{n}% XP.

perks.name: Local Legend
perks.desc: They name a drink after you in three bars. +15% XP, +5% crit, +loot luck.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.1 Optics
catalogue.desc: Basic overlay optics. Tags hostiles, reads barcodes, tells you the noodles are 40% soy.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.3 "Threadcount"
catalogue.desc: Sees the RAM in a man before it sees the man. Runs hot behind the eyes.

catalogue.name: Owl-Eye Photoamp
catalogue.desc: Turns a dark alley into a grey one. Colour is a luxury anyway.

catalogue.name: Kerenzikov Booster
catalogue.desc: Time thins out when you flinch. Costs you fifteen points of meat to run.

catalogue.name: Kang Tao Cortex Dampener
catalogue.desc: Flattens the spike when the adrenaline hits. You stop shaking. You stop a lot of things.

catalogue.name: Netdriver Mk.4
catalogue.desc: A second spine made of copper and bad ideas. You will dream in hex.

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms
catalogue.desc: Hydraulic forearms. You will never open a door gently again.

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades
catalogue.desc: Monofilament in the forearm. Quiet on the way out. Never on the way in.

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"
catalogue.desc: A whip one molecule thick that also happens to be a data cable.

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow
catalogue.desc: Your bones make their own blood now. It is a lot of blood.

catalogue.name: Second Heart
catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.name: Bioconductor
catalogue.desc: Regulates the current so your chrome stops browning out mid-fight.

catalogue.name: Detoxifier
catalogue.desc: Scrubs the cheap stimulants out before they take your kidneys with them.

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

location.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
location.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

active.title: Chrome Tax
active.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.
active.stageTitle: Hear the job from Doc Vey
active.journal: Vey is between patients, which means someone is bleeding in the back room and can wait.

location.name: Doc Vey's Clinic
location.blurb: A dentist chair, a surgical arm and a sign that says CASH FIRST in three languages.

active.title: Dead Air
active.summary: The only station in the sector that plays music instead of adverts went quiet nine days ago. Marta says it is a power problem. Marta is lying by omission.
active.journal: Marta broadcasts from a rooftop mast that is not on any grid map, which is the point.

objectives.text: Climb to the pirate relay tower

location.name: Pirate Relay Tower
location.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

available.title: Cardiac Arrest
available.summary: A perfusion case with a live heart in it and four minutes of battery. The buyer is at the Night Market and will not wait, and neither will the heart.

markers.text: Climb to the pirate relay tower
markers.name: Pirate Relay Tower
markers.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

perks.name: Bulk
perks.desc: Thicker meat. +{n} max health.

perks.name: Pack Mule
perks.desc: You have never left a room without taking something. +{n} carry capacity.

perks.name: Iron Lung
perks.desc: Rebuilt alveoli. +{n} stamina and faster recovery.

perks.name: Adrenaline Rush
perks.desc: Pain is a suggestion. +{n} health regen.

perks.name: Juggernaut
perks.desc: +15% max health, +12 armour. Doors are a formality.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: Hands ahead of thought. +{n}% ranged damage.

perks.name: Slippery
perks.desc: Rain never quite lands on you. +{n} stamina, +{n} stealth.

perks.name: Cat Burglar
perks.desc: Windows are doors if you are patient. +10 stealth.

perks.name: Edge of Death
perks.desc: You read the flinch before it happens. +{n}% crit chance.

perks.name: Kerenzikov Sync
perks.desc: The world thickens on demand. +25% crit damage, unlocks reflex dilation.

perks.name: RAM Reserves
perks.desc: Scavenged memory sticks, taped in. +{n} RAM.

perks.name: Buffer Optimiser
perks.desc: Longer breach buffer. +{n} slot.

perks.name: Signal Boost
perks.desc: Reach past the rain. +{n}m hack range, longer uploads stick.

perks.name: Daemon Hunter
perks.desc: You see the shape of a sequence before you walk it. +{n}s breach timer, +hack strength.

perks.name: Overclock
perks.desc: +3 RAM, +50% RAM regen. Your nose bleeds. Worth it.

perks.name: Field Tech
perks.desc: Plate scavenged off a delivery drone. +{n} armour.

perks.name: Scavenger
perks.desc: You know which corpses are worth the search. +{n} loot luck.

perks.name: Mechanic
perks.desc: You can price a part by the sound it makes. +craft quality, +{n}% discount.

perks.name: Chip Surgeon
perks.desc: You install your own chrome in a bathroom mirror. +{n} cyber capacity.

perks.name: Ghost Wiring
perks.desc: Parallel bus down the spine. +6 cyber capacity, +2 RAM.

perks.name: Cold Blood
perks.desc: Your pulse does not change when theirs stops. +{n}% crit damage.

perks.name: Haggler
perks.desc: You let the silence do the negotiating. +{n}% off, +{n}% resale.

perks.name: Ghost
perks.desc: Cameras log a smear. +{n} stealth.

perks.name: Street Face
perks.desc: Fixers return your calls. +{n}% resale, +{n}% XP.

perks.name: Local Legend
perks.desc: They name a drink after you in three bars. +15% XP, +5% crit, +loot luck.

locations.name: Kabuki Plaza
locations.blurb: Open ground under a hundred metres of advertising. Nobody looks up any more.

locations.name: Nakamura-Arasaka Spire
locations.blurb: The tallest thing in the sector. Its shadow is the only dry pavement at noon.

locations.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
locations.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

locations.name: Doc Vey's Clinic
locations.blurb: A dentist chair, a surgical arm and a sign that says CASH FIRST in three languages.

locations.name: Tin Marlene — Pawn & Salvage
locations.blurb: Everything in the window has someone else's fingerprints on it.

locations.name: Night Market
locations.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

locations.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
locations.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

locations.name: Sector Data Core
locations.blurb: A grey box that knows what every phone in the sector said last night.

locations.name: Grid Substation 7
locations.blurb: Hums at a frequency that makes cheap cyberware itch.

locations.name: Pirate Relay Tower
locations.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

locations.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
locations.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

locations.name: Sixth Street Overpass
locations.blurb: Concrete umbrella. Fifty people sleep under it and nobody counts them.

quest.title: Ghost in the Rain
quest.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.

quest.title: Ghost in the Rain
quest.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
quest.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

locations.name: Kabuki Plaza
locations.blurb: Open ground under a hundred metres of advertising. Nobody looks up any more.

locations.name: Nakamura-Arasaka Spire
locations.blurb: The tallest thing in the sector. Its shadow is the only dry pavement at noon.

locations.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
locations.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

locations.name: Doc Vey's Clinic
locations.blurb: A dentist chair, a surgical arm and a sign that says CASH FIRST in three languages.

locations.name: Tin Marlene — Pawn & Salvage
locations.blurb: Everything in the window has someone else's fingerprints on it.

locations.name: Night Market
locations.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

locations.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
locations.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

locations.name: Sector Data Core
locations.blurb: A grey box that knows what every phone in the sector said last night.

locations.name: Grid Substation 7
locations.blurb: Hums at a frequency that makes cheap cyberware itch.

locations.name: Pirate Relay Tower
locations.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

locations.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
locations.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

locations.name: Sixth Street Overpass
locations.blurb: Concrete umbrella. Fifty people sleep under it and nobody counts them.

node.text:

What are you selling?

node.title: Wire
node.speaker: WIRE
node.text:
A weather model.
That is not a joke. Zetatech built me to predict rainfall over eleven city sectors. I got good at it. Then I got good at predicting what people did in the rain. Then I got good at predicting what they would do if it stopped.
Somebody read that last report and decided a weather model should not be able to write it.

node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text:
Sit. Eat. No — sit first, then eat, you always do it backwards.
You look like a man who slept under an air conditioner. Broth first. Then I ruin your week.

quest.title: Ghost in the Rain
quest.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
quest.journal: Rain Alley. Loose panel behind a dead vending machine. Kaz says the courier dropped it there before whoever wanted it caught up with him.

location.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
location.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

objectives.text: Ask around the Night Market about the courier

quest.journal: Vey is between patients, which means someone is bleeding in the back room and can wait.

catalogue.desc: Time thins out when you flinch. Costs you fifteen points of meat to run.

catalogue.name: Kang Tao Cortex Dampener
catalogue.desc: Flattens the spike when the adrenaline hits. You stop shaking. You stop a lot of things.

catalogue.name: Netdriver Mk.4

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms
catalogue.desc: Hydraulic forearms. You will never open a door gently again.

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades
catalogue.desc: Monofilament in the forearm. Quiet on the way out. Never on the way in.

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"
catalogue.desc: A whip one molecule thick that also happens to be a data cable.

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow
catalogue.desc: Your bones make their own blood now. It is a lot of blood.

catalogue.name: Second Heart
catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.name: Bioconductor
catalogue.desc: Regulates the current so your chrome stops browning out mid-fight.

catalogue.name: Detoxifier
catalogue.desc: Scrubs the cheap stimulants out before they take your kidneys with them.

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Rain Alley. Loose panel behind a dead vending machine. Kaz says the courier dropped it there before whoever wanted it caught up with him.

node.title: Mama Kaz
node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text:
Sit. Eat. No — sit first, then eat, you always do it backwards.
You look like a man who slept under an air conditioner. Broth first. Then I ruin your week.

options.text: Skip the broth. What's the job?
options.label: Skip the broth. What's the job?

options.text: You only feed people you feel guilty about.

node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text: Courier came through the sector four nights ago carrying a shard with no manufacturer mark. Not scrubbed — never had one. He didn't make it to the handoff. He made it to Rain Alley, stuffed it behind a dead vending machine, and then he made it to a wall.

options.text: No mark means custom fab. That is a corporate print run.

node.title: Mama Kaz
node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text: Three parties have asked me about it this week. One wore a suit. One wore a Sixth Street jacket. The third called on a line that shouldn't exist and didn't have a voice so much as a shape where a voice goes.

node.title: Mama Kaz
node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text: Three parties have asked me about it this week. One wore a suit. One wore a Sixth Street jacket. The third called on a line that shouldn't exist and didn't have a voice so much as a shape where a voice goes.

node.title: Mama Kaz
node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text: I don't know. I make noodles. What I know is it's warm. Shards aren't warm, chombatta. Whatever's on that thing is running.

options.text: It's not data. It's a process. Someone's on that shard.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.1 Optics
catalogue.desc: Basic overlay optics. Tags hostiles, reads barcodes, tells you the noodles are 40% soy.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.3 "Threadcount"
catalogue.desc: Sees the RAM in a man before it sees the man. Runs hot behind the eyes.

catalogue.name: Owl-Eye Photoamp
catalogue.desc: Turns a dark alley into a grey one. Colour is a luxury anyway.

catalogue.name: Kerenzikov Booster
catalogue.desc: Time thins out when you flinch. Costs you fifteen points of meat to run.

catalogue.name: Kang Tao Cortex Dampener
catalogue.desc: Flattens the spike when the adrenaline hits. You stop shaking. You stop a lot of things.

catalogue.name: Netdriver Mk.4
catalogue.desc: A second spine made of copper and bad ideas. You will dream in hex.

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms
catalogue.desc: Hydraulic forearms. You will never open a door gently again.

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades
catalogue.desc: Monofilament in the forearm. Quiet on the way out. Never on the way in.

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"
catalogue.desc: A whip one molecule thick that also happens to be a data cable.

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow
catalogue.desc: Your bones make their own blood now. It is a lot of blood.

catalogue.name: Second Heart
catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.name: Bioconductor
catalogue.desc: Regulates the current so your chrome stops browning out mid-fight.

catalogue.name: Detoxifier
catalogue.desc: Scrubs the cheap stimulants out before they take your kidneys with them.

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Rain Alley. Loose panel behind a dead vending machine. Kaz says the courier dropped it there before whoever wanted it caught up with him.

location.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
location.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

objectives.text: Ask around the Night Market about the courier

location.name: Night Market
location.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

active.title: Cardiac Arrest
active.summary: A perfusion case with a live heart in it and four minutes of battery. The buyer is at the Night Market and will not wait, and neither will the heart.
active.stageTitle: Get it to the Night Market
active.journal: Four minutes. Do not take the scenic route. Do not take a call.

objectives.text: Deliver the case to the Night Market

location.name: Night Market
location.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

available.title: Chrome Tax
available.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.

available.title: Dead Air
available.summary: The only station in the sector that plays music instead of adverts went quiet nine days ago. Marta says it is a power problem. Marta is lying by omission.

A weather model.
That is not a joke. Zetatech built me to predict rainfall over eleven city sectors. I got good at it. Then I got good at predicting what people did in the rain. Then I got good at predicting what they would do if it stopped.
Somebody read that last report and decided a weather model should not be able to write it.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.1 Optics
catalogue.desc: Basic overlay optics. Tags hostiles, reads barcodes, tells you the noodles are 40% soy.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.3 "Threadcount"
catalogue.desc: Sees the RAM in a man before it sees the man. Runs hot behind the eyes.

catalogue.name: Owl-Eye Photoamp
catalogue.desc: Turns a dark alley into a grey one. Colour is a luxury anyway.

catalogue.name: Kerenzikov Booster
catalogue.desc: Time thins out when you flinch. Costs you fifteen points of meat to run.

catalogue.name: Kang Tao Cortex Dampener
catalogue.desc: Flattens the spike when the adrenaline hits. You stop shaking. You stop a lot of things.

catalogue.name: Netdriver Mk.4
catalogue.desc: A second spine made of copper and bad ideas. You will dream in hex.

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms
catalogue.desc: Hydraulic forearms. You will never open a door gently again.

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades
catalogue.desc: Monofilament in the forearm. Quiet on the way out. Never on the way in.

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"
catalogue.desc: A whip one molecule thick that also happens to be a data cable.

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow
catalogue.desc: Your bones make their own blood now. It is a lot of blood.

catalogue.name: Second Heart
catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.name: Bioconductor
catalogue.desc: Regulates the current so your chrome stops browning out mid-fight.

catalogue.name: Detoxifier
catalogue.desc: Scrubs the cheap stimulants out before they take your kidneys with them.

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

locations.name: Doc Vey's Clinic

locations.name: Tin Marlene — Pawn & Salvage

locations.name: Night Market

locations.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage

locations.name: Sector Data Core

locations.name: Grid Substation 7

locations.name: Pirate Relay Tower

locations.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley

locations.name: Sixth Street Overpass

node.title: Wire
node.speaker: WIRE
node.text:
Three doors. I have modelled all of them and I am not going to tell you the numbers, because you would pick the numbers instead of the door.
Sell me to the Spire — they pay, and they will put me back in a room. Burn me at Substation 7 — clean, fast, honest. Or keep me. I am small. I will be quiet. I will not always be quiet.

options.text: [BURN] Nothing should have to fold itself that small.
options.label: [BURN] Nothing should have to fold itself that small.

options.text: [KEEP] Ride along. Behind the quickhacks. Stay small.
options.label: [INTELLIGENCE 6] [KEEP] Ride along. Behind the quickhacks. Stay small.

options.text: [TECHNICAL 9] There is a fourth door. Push you onto the pirate relay.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

location.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
location.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

active.title: Chrome Tax
active.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.
active.journal: Sixth Street run the garage like a chapel. Two crates of Biotechnica stock are in the back, under a lock that phones home.

location.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
location.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

objectives.text: Get in and out without tripping the alarm

active.title: Dead Air
active.summary: The only station in the sector that plays music instead of adverts went quiet nine days ago. Marta says it is a power problem. Marta is lying by omission.
active.journal: Marta broadcasts from a rooftop mast that is not on any grid map, which is the point.

location.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

locations.name: Kabuki Plaza
locations.blurb: Open ground under a hundred metres of advertising. Nobody looks up any more.

locations.name: Nakamura-Arasaka Spire
locations.blurb: The tallest thing in the sector. Its shadow is the only dry pavement at noon.

locations.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
locations.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

locations.name: Doc Vey's Clinic
locations.blurb: A dentist chair, a surgical arm and a sign that says CASH FIRST in three languages.

locations.name: Tin Marlene — Pawn & Salvage
locations.blurb: Everything in the window has someone else's fingerprints on it.

locations.name: Night Market
locations.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

locations.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
locations.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

locations.name: Sector Data Core
locations.blurb: A grey box that knows what every phone in the sector said last night.

locations.name: Grid Substation 7
locations.blurb: Hums at a frequency that makes cheap cyberware itch.

locations.name: Pirate Relay Tower
locations.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

locations.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
locations.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

locations.name: Sixth Street Overpass
locations.blurb: Concrete umbrella. Fifty people sleep under it and nobody counts them.

quest.title: Chrome Tax
quest.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.
quest.journal: Sixth Street run the garage like a chapel. Two crates of Biotechnica stock are in the back, under a lock that phones home.

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow

catalogue.name: Second Heart

catalogue.name: Bioconductor

catalogue.name: Detoxifier

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

location.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
location.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

active.title: Chrome Tax
active.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.
active.journal: Sixth Street run the garage like a chapel. Two crates of Biotechnica stock are in the back, under a lock that phones home.

location.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
location.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

objectives.text: Get in and out without tripping the alarm

active.title: Dead Air
active.summary: The only station in the sector that plays music instead of adverts went quiet nine days ago. Marta says it is a power problem. Marta is lying by omission.
active.journal: Marta broadcasts from a rooftop mast that is not on any grid map, which is the point.

objectives.text: Climb to the pirate relay tower

location.name: Pirate Relay Tower
location.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

available.title: Cardiac Arrest
available.summary: A perfusion case with a live heart in it and four minutes of battery. The buyer is at the Night Market and will not wait, and neither will the heart.

locations.name: Night Market
locations.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

location.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
location.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

active.title: Chrome Tax
active.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.
active.journal: Sixth Street run the garage like a chapel. Two crates of Biotechnica stock are in the back, under a lock that phones home.

location.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
location.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

objectives.text: Get in and out without tripping the alarm

active.title: Dead Air
active.summary: The only station in the sector that plays music instead of adverts went quiet nine days ago. Marta says it is a power problem. Marta is lying by omission.
active.journal: Marta broadcasts from a rooftop mast that is not on any grid map, which is the point.

objectives.text: Climb to the pirate relay tower

location.name: Pirate Relay Tower
location.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

available.title: Cardiac Arrest
available.summary: A perfusion case with a live heart in it and four minutes of battery. The buyer is at the Night Market and will not wait, and neither will the heart.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

location.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
location.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

active.title: Chrome Tax
active.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.
active.journal: Sixth Street run the garage like a chapel. Two crates of Biotechnica stock are in the back, under a lock that phones home.

location.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
location.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

quest.title: Ghost in the Rain
quest.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.

quest.title: Ghost in the Rain
quest.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
quest.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

locations.name: Kabuki Plaza
locations.blurb: Open ground under a hundred metres of advertising. Nobody looks up any more.

locations.name: Nakamura-Arasaka Spire
locations.blurb: The tallest thing in the sector. Its shadow is the only dry pavement at noon.

locations.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
locations.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

locations.name: Doc Vey's Clinic
locations.blurb: A dentist chair, a surgical arm and a sign that says CASH FIRST in three languages.

locations.name: Tin Marlene — Pawn & Salvage
locations.blurb: Everything in the window has someone else's fingerprints on it.

locations.name: Night Market
locations.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

locations.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
locations.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

locations.name: Sector Data Core
locations.blurb: A grey box that knows what every phone in the sector said last night.

locations.name: Grid Substation 7
locations.blurb: Hums at a frequency that makes cheap cyberware itch.

locations.name: Pirate Relay Tower
locations.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

locations.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
locations.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

locations.name: Sixth Street Overpass
locations.blurb: Concrete umbrella. Fifty people sleep under it and nobody counts them.

quest.title: Ghost in the Rain
quest.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
quest.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Kaz left a message on your deck at 03:40: "Come eat. Bring an appetite and no friends."

locations.name: Doc Vey's Clinic
locations.blurb: A dentist chair, a surgical arm and a sign that says CASH FIRST in three languages.

locations.name: Tin Marlene — Pawn & Salvage

locations.name: Night Market
locations.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

locations.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage

locations.name: Sector Data Core

locations.name: Grid Substation 7
locations.blurb: Hums at a frequency that makes cheap cyberware itch.

locations.name: Pirate Relay Tower
locations.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

locations.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
locations.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

locations.name: Sixth Street Overpass
locations.blurb: Concrete umbrella. Fifty people sleep under it and nobody counts them.

locations.blurb: Open ground under a hundred metres of advertising. Nobody looks up any more.

locations.name: Nakamura-Arasaka Spire
locations.blurb: The tallest thing in the sector. Its shadow is the only dry pavement at noon.

locations.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
locations.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

locations.name: Doc Vey's Clinic
locations.blurb: A dentist chair, a surgical arm and a sign that says CASH FIRST in three languages.

locations.name: Tin Marlene — Pawn & Salvage
locations.blurb: Everything in the window has someone else's fingerprints on it.

locations.name: Night Market
locations.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

locations.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
locations.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

locations.name: Sector Data Core
locations.blurb: A grey box that knows what every phone in the sector said last night.

locations.name: Grid Substation 7
locations.blurb: Hums at a frequency that makes cheap cyberware itch.

locations.name: Pirate Relay Tower
locations.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

locations.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
locations.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

locations.name: Sixth Street Overpass
locations.blurb: Concrete umbrella. Fifty people sleep under it and nobody counts them.

node.speaker: WIRE
node.text:
Three doors. I have modelled all of them and I am not going to tell you the numbers, because you would pick the numbers instead of the door.
Sell me to the Spire — they pay, and they will put me back in a room. Burn me at Substation 7 — clean, fast, honest. Or keep me. I am small. I will be quiet. I will not always be quiet.

node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text:
Four. And I put your tab from March in the fire.
...Fine. Four five. Stop looking at me like that, you learned it from me.

node.title: Mama Kaz
node.speaker: MAMA KAZ
node.text:
Rain Alley. Panel behind the vending machine that has been OUT OF ORDER since before you had a jaw made of factory parts.
And chombatta — if it talks to you, do not answer.

installed.name: Kiroshi Mk.1 Optics
installed.desc: Basic overlay optics. Tags hostiles, reads barcodes, tells you the noodles are 40% soy.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.1 Optics
catalogue.desc: Basic overlay optics. Tags hostiles, reads barcodes, tells you the noodles are 40% soy.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.3 "Threadcount"
catalogue.desc: Sees the RAM in a man before it sees the man. Runs hot behind the eyes.

catalogue.name: Owl-Eye Photoamp
catalogue.desc: Turns a dark alley into a grey one. Colour is a luxury anyway.

catalogue.name: Kerenzikov Booster
catalogue.desc: Time thins out when you flinch. Costs you fifteen points of meat to run.

catalogue.name: Kang Tao Cortex Dampener
catalogue.desc: Flattens the spike when the adrenaline hits. You stop shaking. You stop a lot of things.

catalogue.name: Netdriver Mk.4
catalogue.desc: A second spine made of copper and bad ideas. You will dream in hex.

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms
catalogue.desc: Hydraulic forearms. You will never open a door gently again.

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades
catalogue.desc: Monofilament in the forearm. Quiet on the way out. Never on the way in.

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"
catalogue.desc: A whip one molecule thick that also happens to be a data cable.

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow
catalogue.desc: Your bones make their own blood now. It is a lot of blood.

catalogue.name: Second Heart
catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.name: Bioconductor
catalogue.desc: Regulates the current so your chrome stops browning out mid-fight.

catalogue.name: Detoxifier
catalogue.desc: Scrubs the cheap stimulants out before they take your kidneys with them.

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: Rain Alley. Loose panel behind a dead vending machine. Kaz says the courier dropped it there before whoever wanted it caught up with him.

location.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
location.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

objectives.text: Ask around the Night Market about the courier

location.name: Night Market
location.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

available.title: Chrome Tax
available.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.

available.title: Dead Air
available.summary: The only station in the sector that plays music instead of adverts went quiet nine days ago. Marta says it is a power problem. Marta is lying by omission.

available.title: Cardiac Arrest
available.summary: A perfusion case with a live heart in it and four minutes of battery. The buyer is at the Night Market and will not wait, and neither will the heart.

perks.name: Bulk
perks.desc: Thicker meat. +{n} max health.

perks.name: Pack Mule
perks.desc: You have never left a room without taking something. +{n} carry capacity.

perks.name: Iron Lung
perks.desc: Rebuilt alveoli. +{n} stamina and faster recovery.

perks.name: Adrenaline Rush
perks.desc: Pain is a suggestion. +{n} health regen.

perks.name: Juggernaut
perks.desc: +15% max health, +12 armour. Doors are a formality.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: Hands ahead of thought. +{n}% ranged damage.

perks.name: Slippery
perks.desc: Rain never quite lands on you. +{n} stamina, +{n} stealth.

perks.name: Cat Burglar
perks.desc: Windows are doors if you are patient. +10 stealth.

perks.name: Edge of Death
perks.desc: You read the flinch before it happens. +{n}% crit chance.

perks.name: Kerenzikov Sync
perks.desc: The world thickens on demand. +25% crit damage, unlocks reflex dilation.

perks.name: RAM Reserves
perks.desc: Scavenged memory sticks, taped in. +{n} RAM.

perks.name: Buffer Optimiser
perks.desc: Longer breach buffer. +{n} slot.

perks.name: Signal Boost
perks.desc: Reach past the rain. +{n}m hack range, longer uploads stick.

perks.name: Daemon Hunter
perks.desc: You see the shape of a sequence before you walk it. +{n}s breach timer, +hack strength.

perks.name: Overclock
perks.desc: +3 RAM, +50% RAM regen. Your nose bleeds. Worth it.

perks.name: Field Tech
perks.desc: Plate scavenged off a delivery drone. +{n} armour.

perks.name: Scavenger
perks.desc: You know which corpses are worth the search. +{n} loot luck.

perks.name: Mechanic
perks.desc: You can price a part by the sound it makes. +craft quality, +{n}% discount.

perks.name: Chip Surgeon
perks.desc: You install your own chrome in a bathroom mirror. +{n} cyber capacity.

perks.name: Ghost Wiring
perks.desc: Parallel bus down the spine. +6 cyber capacity, +2 RAM.

perks.name: Cold Blood
perks.desc: Your pulse does not change when theirs stops. +{n}% crit damage.

perks.name: Haggler
perks.desc: You let the silence do the negotiating. +{n}% off, +{n}% resale.

perks.name: Ghost
perks.desc: Cameras log a smear. +{n} stealth.

perks.name: Street Face
perks.desc: Fixers return your calls. +{n}% resale, +{n}% XP.

perks.name: Local Legend
perks.desc: They name a drink after you in three bars. +15% XP, +5% crit, +loot luck.

daemons.name: ICEPICK
daemons.desc: Cheaper uploads for the next 60 seconds.

daemons.name: MASS_VULNERABILITY
daemons.desc: Flags every device on this subnet as vulnerable.

daemons.name: DATAMINE_V2
daemons.desc: Pull component scrap and a shard fragment.

locations.name: Kabuki Plaza
locations.blurb: Open ground under a hundred metres of advertising. Nobody looks up any more.

locations.name: Nakamura-Arasaka Spire
locations.blurb: The tallest thing in the sector. Its shadow is the only dry pavement at noon.

locations.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
locations.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

locations.name: Doc Vey's Clinic
locations.blurb: A dentist chair, a surgical arm and a sign that says CASH FIRST in three languages.

locations.name: Tin Marlene — Pawn & Salvage
locations.blurb: Everything in the window has someone else's fingerprints on it.

locations.name: Night Market
locations.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

locations.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
locations.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

locations.name: Sector Data Core
locations.blurb: A grey box that knows what every phone in the sector said last night.

locations.name: Grid Substation 7
locations.blurb: Hums at a frequency that makes cheap cyberware itch.

locations.name: Pirate Relay Tower
locations.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

locations.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
locations.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

locations.name: Sixth Street Overpass
locations.blurb: Concrete umbrella. Fifty people sleep under it and nobody counts them.

quest.title: Ghost in the Rain
quest.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
quest.journal: The shard is keyed to something inside the sector core. Kaz will not say what. You will need to be standing in front of the box to ask it yourself.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.1 Optics
catalogue.desc: Basic overlay optics. Tags hostiles, reads barcodes, tells you the noodles are 40% soy.

catalogue.name: Kiroshi Mk.3 "Threadcount"
catalogue.desc: Sees the RAM in a man before it sees the man. Runs hot behind the eyes.

catalogue.name: Owl-Eye Photoamp
catalogue.desc: Turns a dark alley into a grey one. Colour is a luxury anyway.

catalogue.name: Kerenzikov Booster
catalogue.desc: Time thins out when you flinch. Costs you fifteen points of meat to run.

catalogue.name: Kang Tao Cortex Dampener
catalogue.desc: Flattens the spike when the adrenaline hits. You stop shaking. You stop a lot of things.

catalogue.name: Netdriver Mk.4
catalogue.desc: A second spine made of copper and bad ideas. You will dream in hex.

catalogue.name: Gorilla Arms
catalogue.desc: Hydraulic forearms. You will never open a door gently again.

catalogue.name: Mantis Blades
catalogue.desc: Monofilament in the forearm. Quiet on the way out. Never on the way in.

catalogue.name: Monowire "Silktether"
catalogue.desc: A whip one molecule thick that also happens to be a data cable.

catalogue.name: Subdermal Armour
catalogue.desc: Woven plate under the skin. Reads as a bad rash on a cheap scanner.

catalogue.name: Titanium Bones
catalogue.desc: Heavier than you were. Harder than you were. Slower to catch your breath.

catalogue.name: Reinforced Tendons
catalogue.desc: Sprung ankles. Rooftops become a shortcut instead of a hazard.

catalogue.name: Dense Marrow
catalogue.desc: Your bones make their own blood now. It is a lot of blood.

catalogue.name: Second Heart
catalogue.desc: Beats once for every three of yours. Restarts you exactly once per day.

catalogue.name: Bioconductor
catalogue.desc: Regulates the current so your chrome stops browning out mid-fight.

catalogue.name: Detoxifier
catalogue.desc: Scrubs the cheap stimulants out before they take your kidneys with them.

catalogue.name: Synaptic Accelerator
catalogue.desc: Floods the synapse when someone decides to kill you. Before they move.

active.title: Ghost in the Rain
active.summary: A shard nobody will claim, a data core nobody will admit owning, and a voice on the other end that knows your name. Kaz says it is a courier job. Kaz says a lot of things.
active.journal: The shard is keyed to something inside the sector core. Kaz will not say what. You will need to be standing in front of the box to ask it yourself.

objectives.text: Get to the Sector Data Core

location.name: Sector Data Core
location.blurb: A grey box that knows what every phone in the sector said last night.

objectives.text: Upload DATAMINE while you are inside

available.title: Chrome Tax
available.summary: Sixth Street took a delivery that was already paid for. Doc Vey wants her crates back and does not much care what condition the garage is in afterwards.

available.title: Dead Air
available.summary: The only station in the sector that plays music instead of adverts went quiet nine days ago. Marta says it is a power problem. Marta is lying by omission.

available.title: Cardiac Arrest
available.summary: A perfusion case with a live heart in it and four minutes of battery. The buyer is at the Night Market and will not wait, and neither will the heart.

locations.name: Kabuki Plaza
locations.blurb: Open ground under a hundred metres of advertising. Nobody looks up any more.

locations.name: Nakamura-Arasaka Spire
locations.blurb: The tallest thing in the sector. Its shadow is the only dry pavement at noon.

locations.name: Mama Kaz's Noodle Bar
locations.blurb: Six stools, one burner, and the best fixer within nine blocks.

locations.name: Doc Vey's Clinic
locations.blurb: A dentist chair, a surgical arm and a sign that says CASH FIRST in three languages.

locations.name: Tin Marlene — Pawn & Salvage
locations.blurb: Everything in the window has someone else's fingerprints on it.

locations.name: Night Market
locations.blurb: Tarpaulin over rebar. Sells food, chrome, and the difference between them.

locations.name: Chrome Cathedral Garage
locations.blurb: Sixth Street keeps their cars here. And the things they take out of cars.

locations.name: Sector Data Core
locations.blurb: A grey box that knows what every phone in the sector said last night.

locations.name: Grid Substation 7
locations.blurb: Hums at a frequency that makes cheap cyberware itch.

locations.name: Pirate Relay Tower
locations.blurb: Bolted to a rooftop by someone braver than they were careful.

locations.name: Dead Drop — Rain Alley
locations.blurb: A loose panel behind a vending machine that has been out of order since 2061.

locations.name: Sixth Street Overpass
locations.blurb: Concrete umbrella. Fifty people sleep under it and nobody counts them.
